outcome: Month-end and the payments list read the live Finance data
acceptance_criteria: Month-end calls the live path with the chosen month — verify: with the mock running, open `/finance/month-end?period=2026-10`; the request log shows `GET /api/v1/month-end?month=2026-10` and no `/api/v1/finance/month-end`; `?period=2026-13` sends no request and shows the existing "month not recognised" state.

Task rows come from `work[]` with label, workspace and time, and counts include Stopped — verify: page shows the fixture's rows, tags read the returned `label`, and the counts read Done 2, Waiting 1, In progress 3, Stopped 1; no "of N" total appears.
Show more appends the next page — verify: with `next_page: 2` the page requests `page=2`, appends rows, keeps page 1's counts; the control disappears when `next_page` is null.

Cash is never 0 and never summed — verify: fixture with a `cash_unavailable` workspace shows "By project" and that workspace's line reads "Unknown"; the two-currency fixture shows two lines and no combined figure; `more_cash_groups: true` shows "More projects are not shown here"; a unit test of the cash view asserts no path returns "0" or "₦0" for a missing, unavailable or malformed amount.

Hidden parts are absent — verify: month-end shows no agent note, no next-action button and no restricted-row text; payments shows no RECEIVED THIS MONTH, BANK DATA TO, "N INVOICES" or note panel (assert in tests).

Payments calls the live path — verify: `/finance/payments?q=kora&status=overdue` requests `GET /api/v1/payments?q=kora&state=overdue`; "Show more" requests `cursor=c2` and appends; `status=bogus` sends no `state`; no request goes to `/api/v1/finance/invoices`.

Unknown money shows Unknown with its basis — verify: the `owed: null` row shows "Unknown" in STILL OWED (not "0.00"), and the `totals[].owed` null shows "Unknown" in OWED TO PSL; known amounts show currency and basis; a two-currency `totals` shows two values, not one sum.
`limited` shows the partial-result callout — verify: fixture with `limited: true` shows "Partial result. This list and its totals may not include every invoice."; with `false` it is absent.

Action links follow the API — verify: a row with `reminder_url` shows "Open the reminder" linking to that URL; a row with null `record_payment_url` shows "Record a payment" disabled with "Not available to you for this invoice" and it is not an anchor; pressing it does nothing; no test or page code calls `/api/v1/finance/invoices/*` or `/api/v1/work` for these actions.
AGE is not worded as overdue — verify: the column header reads AGE and rows read "9 days"; no cell or card says "overdue by" or "days overdue".

Wrong user and failures — verify: persona without finance access gets 403 on both pages and shows the no-access card with no invoice or task data; 401 shows the signed-out state; mock `error` variant shows the error card, and Try again re-reads; a failed "Show more" keeps the rows and shows an inline retry; a 200 body missing `items` or `counts` shows the error card.

Both mock routes match the live contract — verify: `npx vitest run tests/mock-live-finance.test.ts` validates every month-end and invoices fixture and each served variant against the live `200` schemas of `/api/v1/month-end` and `/api/v1/payments` with Ajv (`strict: true`, `ajv-formats`, as `tests/mock-live-me.test.ts`), and asserts no field outside the contract is served (`additionalProperties: false`).
No writes — verify: grep the two feature folders for `api.POST`, `liveApi.POST`, `receipts`, `/receivables`, `/payments/` with a path parameter: none; both pages send only GET.

The existing design checks still pass — verify: `python3 delivery/design.py check` (run from the worktree's project root as the gate does) and the existing SCR-36 and SCR-20 fidelity checks show the same layout, with only the parts hidden by the defaults missing.

Against Django 8010 (integration owner, recorded in `build.md`) — verify: signed in as a Finance user, `/finance/month-end` and `/finance/payments` render the live data without console errors; as a non-Finance user both show the no-access card.

risk.rationale: Medium. The change is read-only and conforms to boards that are already approved. It still replaces a v7 route and response with a different live shape on two built Finance pages, which is a cross-layer contract change. The null-to-Unknown rule is a correctness risk if mapped wrong, because Unknown must never become 0. The high-risk writes (payments, allocation, short-payment, receivables capture) are excluded. Surfaces: ui, api, contract-change, and product-decision for the hidden-field defaults and the `limited` and `age_days` wording. Product acceptance is required because the client sees changed pages with fewer figures.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
